summary: Recent changes to the Firefox browser's integration with **WebRTC**, the technology enabling real-time communication like video calls, have focused on improving video quality and resource management. The integration now includes support for **RTX (Retransmission) SSRC** (Synchronization Source identifiers) and retransmission stats, which help manage video streams more effectively, particularly in challenging network conditions. Firefox will also continue using hardware acceleration for decoding H.264 video, ensuring smoother performance when a software decoder isn't available. Additionally, the browser will avoid sending Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency (DTMF) signals—the tones used for phone keypad input—from disabled video feeds, further enhancing the clarity and efficiency of communication. These updates contribute to more reliable and efficient video calling experiences for users.
